title: A busy family
instructions: Maria ailesinin haftalık programını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; kim hangi gün ne yapıyor, karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: My family is very busy during the week.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: On Mondays, my son Leo has swimming lessons after school, at four o'clock.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: My daughter Emma has piano lessons on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: My husband works late on Wednesdays, so I cook dinner. On the other days, he cooks.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: On Fridays, we usually eat pizza and watch a film together. It's my favourite evening.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: On Saturday mornings, I go to the market and the children play football.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: On Sundays, we visit my parents. They live in a village forty minutes from our house.

script.speaker: maria
script.text: We don't have much free time, but we are happy.

questions.prompt: When does Leo have swimming lessons?
questions.feedback: Leo pazartesi (on Mondays) yüzmeye gidiyor. Salı ve perşembe Emma'nın piyano günleri.
questions.evidence: On Mondays, my son Leo has swimming lessons

questions.prompt: How often does Emma have piano lessons?
questions.feedback: Salı ve perşembe: haftada iki kez.
questions.evidence: My daughter Emma has piano lessons on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

questions.feedback: Eşi çarşamba geç çalışıyor, o gün Maria yemek yapıyor. Diğer günler eşi pişiriyor.
questions.evidence: My husband works late on Wednesdays, so I cook dinner.

questions.feedback: Cuma akşamı pizza ve film; en sevdiği akşam.

questions.prompt: How far is her parents' village?
questions.feedback: Köy evlerine kırk dakika (forty minutes) uzaklıkta.
questions.evidence: They live in a village forty minutes from our house.
